title: Billie Holiday joins Shaw; Leeman's first wife Selma Cord
summary: Sy Schribman arranges for Billie Holiday to join the white band, and Shaw hires Leeman's wife Selma Cord as the band singer.

story.theme_name: Singers and the musicians who accompanied them
story.community_name: Billie Holiday as the musicians knew her

blocks.x: Now, Sy Schribman had something to do with Basie's band on the road, and Billie Holiday was signing with the band for a short while, but I don't think she liked the one nighters with Basie, so anyway, somehow Schribman wanted Billie Holiday to come with us to see how it worked out with Artie Shaw and his white orchestra. This was in New England, now.

And Artie Shaw insisted on what he wanted in life, and he wanted Billie Holiday who was just as great then as the day she died. In order to come with our band, and we were doing ballrooms, Sy Schribman had the idea that Billie should come on as a single and they should have a white vocalist that sat on the bandstand, and perform with the band. And Billie would come on as a single and perform her bit.

My first wife -- her name was Selma Cord; Artie hired her as a singer, she had sung around the clubs in Boston, and she was very young but she had a good voice, [and her] and Pete gave her the name Nita Bradley. Now we were married, we were on the road with Artie Shaw, but
* Boston-based Ballroom owner and band leader.
